text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. Machine learning is a key part of AI: instead of following fixed instructions, computers learn from data and improve over time. Deep learning, a more advanced form, uses large artificial neural networks to recognise patterns in huge amounts of information. Today AI is part of everyday life. It helps search engines find answers, suggests films and music we might enjoy, powers voice assistants on our phones, and even supports doctors in diagnosing illnesses.
